reason: Both conversations reach the right diagnosis (blocked defrost drain), give the same safe fix (cotton bud or pipe cleaner and warm water, nothing sharp near the cooling pipes) and need no part or escalation. Conversation 1 explains the auto-defrost mechanism more accurately and stays focused. It also closes honestly, saying to keep an eye on it, with the drip tray and door seal as the next checks. Conversation 2 pads its first reply with irrelevant items such as a water dispenser or ice maker, and it describes the hole's position vaguely. It also ends by declaring that 'nothing else is wrong' after only a few dry days, which overstates certainty. Its small-cup drain test and the Beko drain-tool tip are useful, which keeps the margin slight.
